sloka: अयं चास्मै प्रदातव्यो यत्नात् सुपरिरक्षितः ।ब्रुवता वचनान्येवं सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः ।। ५.६५.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: ayaṁ cāsmai pradātavyo yatnāt suparirakṣitaḥ ।bruvatā vacanānyevaṁ sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ ।। 5.65.21 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Within hearing of Sugriva, tell him about your efforts. Present this(signet) to Rama carefully preserved by me.
